messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — during final rehearsal we saw a flicker on the HDMI feed in the main room. If it drops during the live all-hands well need to pivot to the backup laptop + USB capture.

sachin: Got it. Ill place the spare MacBook on Table B with the USB-C capture dongle. Do we want that to mirror slides or just record locally?

jordan: Mirror slides and record locally. Streaming from the spare increases network complexity.

elaine: Who's coordinating post-allhands follow-ups? I can collect Qs in the doc but need someone to drive answers and action items.

marta: I can own leadership follow-ups. Tag items with #allhands-followup and assign to me for the first pass.

maria: Plan: 1) spare laptop on Table B using HDMI->USB capture, 2) OBS scene preloaded (slides + camera), 3) local recording to external SSD as primary fallback.

austin: OBS fallback command we validated:
```bash
obs-cli --profile fallback --scene "Allhands Backup" --start-recording --output /media/ssd/allhands-$(date +%s).mkv
```
Use that if main encoder fails.

sachin: Copy. SSD will be formatted and labeled. Ill run the fallback command at 10:15 to confirm.

maria: Captioning: caption-bot will run on the stream. Also export a manual VTT from the caption tool in case live captions disconnect. caption-bot, any export steps?

caption-bot: Running en-US model, 1s latency target. If transcription drops: Settings -> Export -> Save VTT. Also keep the last 15s buffer for easier resync.

elaine: Q&A workflow: during live Q&A, drop audience questions into the shared #allhands-questions doc (link to be posted). Ill triage and then send to Marta for final answers.

jordan: Ill post the doc link and a Slack reminder at T-5 for attendees to add questions there.

marta: Keep public answers concise; for engineering-level requests, tag @sachin and @jordan so we can create issues. For customer/partner queries ping Sales.

maria: Ops checklist before go-live: spare laptop ready, SSD formatted (ext4), OBS fallback loaded, backup recording started before official start, captions running, Q&A doc link shared.

sachin: SSD formatted and labeled: ALLHANDS-BACKUP. Doing a dry-run record now, will paste the log snippet below.

maria: Dry-run log snippet:
```
[10:18:02] obs: profile loaded: fallback
[10:18:03] obs: scene init: Allhands Backup
[10:18:04] recorder: writing /media/ssd/allhands-1700000000.mkv
```

elaine: Also add a column in the Q&A doc for "asked by" so we can trace follow-ups to individuals.

marta: Agreed. Also mark any question related to product roadmap so PMs can capture it in the roadmap issue tracker.

maria: Ill be on-site and will confirm "ready" at T-2. If HDMI drops, switch to USB capture and post here immediately. :thumbsup: 

jordan: Posting Q&A doc and reminder now.

caption-bot: Reminder set: at T-5 Ill report captions status into this thread.

marta: Thanks team. Keep the runbook tight and avoid adding extra streams unless we need them for redundancy.
